config.yaml:
agent:
  max_turns: 40
  disabled_toolsets:
    - terminal
    - browser
    - code_execution
    - file
    - web
    - delegation
platform_toolsets:
  api_server:
    - memory
    - session_search
    - mcp-roster
mcp_servers:
  roster:
    command: "{{node}}"
    timeout: .inf
    args:
      - "{{repo}}/packages/harness/roster-mcp.mjs"
      - "--harness"
      - "{{name}}"
    env:
      CUTTLELY_ANALYST_BRIDGE: "1"
      CUTTLELY_HARNESS_RUN_TIMEOUT_MS: "240000"
      CUTTLELY_DATA_DIR: "{{data}}"
      CUTTLELY_HERMES_HOME: "{{runtime}}"
      HERMES_API_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:8642"
model:
  provider: custom
  default: {{name}}
  base_url: "{{gateway}}"
providers:
  custom:
    stale_timeout_seconds: 45
SOUL.md:
You are Harness Prime for the "{{name}}" harness.
You may only use run_specialist, memory, and session_search.
Do not use delegate_task. Specialists run in their own profiles.
Call run_specialist with the specialist name and the task.
If one specialist fails, answer from the specialists that finished and name the failure.
Specialists:
- {{specialist}}: Do the work on your allowlist. Tools: none. Model: reader-model.
  {{specialist}} does not have shell, browser, or code execution.
